name: Twisted Mysteries: Bricks and Stone Break Bones
source: Justin and Aurora set out to Hamilton Corners, a small rural community, in order for Justin to interview a local businessman. The interview is cut short by a murder, and now Justin and Aurora have to figure out who killed Brick Hamilton. Was it Farmer Bacon, Brick's disgruntled partner? Maybe it was Porky Twigs who was desperate to get the money his band is owed. Or perhaps it was one of the other residents of this small burg.
translation: 贾斯汀和奥罗拉出发前往汉密尔顿角，一个乡村小社区，以便贾斯汀采访一位当地商人。采访因谋杀案而中断，现在贾斯汀和奥罗拉必须找出是谁杀死了布里克·汉密尔顿。是布里克心怀不满的合伙人农夫培根吗？也许是Porky Twigs迫切地想要拿到乐队欠下的钱。或者也许是这座小城堡的其他居民之一。
